about.welcome_text_p1: Maurya Hospital, managed by Anagha Healthcare, is a premier multi-specialty medical facility in Mysuru, Karnataka. Since our inception, we have been committed to raising the standard of affordable, advanced healthcare. Our clinical framework brings together a panel of highly experienced medical specialists, dedicated nursing professionals, and modern diagnostic technologies.
about.welcome_text_p2: We believe that quality medical care should be compassionate, transparent, and accessible to all sections of the community. From round-the-clock emergency responses and advanced ICU care to specialized surgical interventions (including Neuro, Spine, Orthopedics, and Plastic Surgery), we deliver seamless medical service when it matters most.
about.welcome_text_p3: Our facility is equipped with state-of-the-art operating systems, a fully automated laboratory, and a 24/7 advanced CT imaging unit, ensuring accurate diagnostics and safe clinical outcomes for every patient.
about.vision_desc: To emerge as the most trusted healthcare destination in the region, recognized for compassionate patient care, ethical clinical practices, and advanced medical infrastructure at affordable rates.
about.mission_desc: To deliver high-quality, evidence-based medical treatment using modern technology, clinical expertise, and compassionate nursing care, while prioritizing patient safety and transparency.
about.values_desc: Integrity, compassion, clinical excellence, patient-first care, and transparency in all healthcare practices and billing structures.
about.infra_desc: Explore our advanced medical setup designed for precision diagnosis and patient comfort.
about.infra_p1_desc: Laminar flow air systems, anesthesia workstations, and high-definition endoscopic surgeries.
about.infra_p2_desc: Continuous patient monitoring systems, isolation wards, and immediate emergency resuscitation.
about.infra_p3_desc: Fully automated biochemistry and hematology analyzers for fast and accurate clinical reporting.

leadership.title: Management Information
leadership.p1: Maurya Hospital is owned and managed by Anagha Healthcare, a committed healthcare organization based in Mysuru, Karnataka. Under the guidance of our leadership team, the hospital prioritizes absolute transparency in clinical outcomes, strict adherence to national health guidelines, and maintaining state-of-the-art support systems.
leadership.p2: Our directors and senior administrators work in coordination with senior clinical consultants, ensuring that both diagnostic imaging and patient surgical care are delivered with optimal efficiency and care.

ct_imaging.title: 24/7 Advanced CT Imaging Services
ct_imaging.subtitle: Equipped with Siemens Somatom Scope CT scan systems, providing high-resolution diagnostic capabilities.
ct_imaging.f1_desc: High-fidelity orthopedic and bone modeling for precise surgical planning and fracture evaluation.
ct_imaging.f2_desc: Non-invasive vascular and cardiac studies visualizing arteries, circulation, and vascular blockages.
ct_imaging.f3_desc: Specialized abdomen and organ contrast scans tracking contrast washouts over distinct timelines.
ct_imaging.f4_desc: Rapid whole-body scanning for multi-trauma assessments, vital in emergency and acute care.
ct_imaging.f5_desc: Specialized protocols ensuring safe, high-resolution diagnostic imaging with minimal radiation.
ct_imaging.f6_desc: Siemens software optimization providing maximum imaging detail at lowest feasible radiation exposure.
